title: Free ChatGPT for transitioning U.S. servicemembers and veterans
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial

body:
OpenAI is offering U.S. servicemembers and veterans within 12 months of retirement or separation a free year of ChatGPT Plus to support their transition to civilian life. The tools can help with resumes, interviews, education, and planning for what’s next.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-veterans).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
